meanings.meaning: 竞赛（指速度竞赛活动） adjective. 赛车的

meanings.usage: 指把信息写下来或录制

meanings.meaning: 记录（指最佳成绩或官方记载） verb. 记录

meanings.usage: 指物体运动的快慢程度
指提供动力的机械装置
指做某事时遇到的障碍

meanings.meaning: 平均的（指多个数值的中间值） noun. 平均数

meanings.usage: 指因期望落空而感到不开心

meanings.meaning: 努力（指试图做某事的行为） verb. 尝试

meanings.usage: 指到达某个地点或程度
指对某物进行管理或支配
follow in someone's footsteps表示继承某人的事业
指物体从一端到另一端的距离

phrases.phrase: set up a new world record

examples.en: She set up a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
examples.zh: 她在百米赛跑中创造了新的世界纪录。

phrases.phrase: have great difficulty in doing something
phrases.usage: 在做某事方面有很大困难

examples.en: He had great difficulty in controlling the car.
examples.zh: 他在控制汽车方面有很大困难。

examples.en: I was disappointed to learn that the concert was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我失望地得知音乐会取消了。

examples.en: The train can reach speeds of over 300 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 这列火车可以达到每小时300公里以上的速度。

phrases.usage: 追随某人的脚步；继承衣钵

examples.en: She followed in her mother's footsteps and became a doctor.
examples.zh: 她追随母亲的脚步，成为了一名医生。

examples.en: The racing car drove at over 200 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 这辆赛车以超过每小时200英里的速度行驶。

examples.en: A few days later, we received the good news.
examples.zh: 几天后，我们收到了好消息。

examples.en: This car was specially built for the racing competition.
examples.zh: 这辆车是为赛车比赛专门建造的。

examples.en: Although it was raining, we still went out.
examples.zh: 虽然下雨了，但我们还是出去了。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，或称为"过去的过去" 用于描述两个发生在过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时

examples.en: He was disappointed because his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 他很失望，因为他的平均速度是299英里/小时。

examples.en: A few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
examples.zh: 几天后，有人告诉他一个错误已经犯了。

grammar.title: although 引导的让步状语从句
grammar.structure: Although + 主语 + 动词(从句), 主语 + 动词(主句)
grammar.definition: although引导让步状语从句，表示"虽然...但是..." although引导的从句放在句首，修饰主句的转折关系。注意：although和but不能同时使用

examples.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car.
examples.zh: 虽然坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里以上的速度，但他很难控制汽车。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + be + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
grammar.definition: 当动作的承受者作为句子的主语时，使用被动语态 用于强调动作的承受者或不知道动作执行者时

examples.en: Bluebird had been specially built for him.
examples.zh: 蓝鸟号是专门为他建造的。

examples.en: He was told that a mistake had been made.
examples.zh: 有人告诉他犯了一个错误。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 形容词 + to do something

original.en: Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
original.zh: 坎贝尔失望地得知他的平均速度是299英里/小时。

imitations.en: She was happy to hear the good news.
imitations.zh: 她高兴地听到这个消息。

imitations.en: I was surprised to see him there.
imitations.zh: 我很惊讶在那里见到他。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + set up + a + 形容词 + world record + 时间/地点

original.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
original.zh: 1935年9月，他在犹他州的博纳维尤盐沼创造了新的世界纪录。

imitations.en: She set up a new world record in the Olympic Games.
imitations.zh: 她在奥运会上创造了新的世界纪录。

imitations.en: He set up a new record at the age of 25.
imitations.zh: 他在25岁时创造了新的纪录。

patterns.pattern: although + 主语 + 动词..., 主语 + 动词...

original.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car.
original.zh: 虽然坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里以上的速度，但他很难控制汽车。

imitations.en: Although it was very cold, we went swimming.
imitations.zh: 虽然天气很冷，我们还是去游泳了。

imitations.en: Although she studied hard, she failed the exam.
imitations.zh: 虽然她学习很努力，但她考试没通过。

patterns.pattern: Following in someone's footsteps, 主语 + 动词

original.en: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son also set up a world record.
original.zh: 多年后，继承父亲的衣钵，坎贝尔爵士的儿子也创造了世界纪录。

imitations.en: Following in her teacher's footsteps, she became a professor.
imitations.zh: 继承她老师的衣钵，她成为了一名教授。

imitations.en: Following in his brother's footsteps, he joined the army.
imitations.zh: 追随他哥哥的脚步，他参了军。

lines.en: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
lines.zh: 杰出的赛车选手马尔科姆。坎贝尔爵士是第一个以每小时超过300英里的速度驾车的人。

lines.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
lines.zh: 他于1935年9月在犹他州的邦纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。

lines.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
lines.zh: 他驾驶的“蓝鸟”牌汽车是专门为他制造的。

lines.en: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2,500- horsepower engine.
lines.zh: 它的车身长30英尺，有一个2,500马力的发动机。

lines.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
lines.zh: 尽管坎贝尔达到了每小时超过304英里的速度，但他很难把汽车控制住，因为在开始的行程中爆了一只轮胎。

lines.en: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
lines.zh: 比赛结束后，坎贝尔非常失望地得知他的平均时速是299英里。

lines.en: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
lines.zh: 然而，几天之后，有人告诉他说弄错了。

lines.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
lines.zh: 他的平均时速实际是301英里。

lines.en: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
lines.zh: 从那时以来，赛车选手已达到每小时600英里的速度。

lines.en: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
lines.zh: 很多年之后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德踏着父亲的足迹，也创造了一项世界纪录。

lines.en: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
lines.zh: 同他父亲一样，他也驾驶着一辆名叫“蓝鸟”的汽车。

questions.a: His average speed had been recorded as 299 miles per hour, but a mistake had been made: it was actually 301 miles per hour.
questions.aZh: 他的平均时速被算作299英里，其实是弄错了，真正的平均时速是301英里。
questions.hint: 见 a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made。

questions.q: What do we know about the car called Bluebird?
questions.zh: 关于“蓝鸟”这辆车，我们了解到什么？
questions.a: It had been specially built for Campbell. It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2,500-horsepower engine.
questions.aZh: 它是专为坎贝尔制造的，车身长30多英尺，装有一台2500马力的发动机。

questions.q: Why did Campbell have great difficulty in controlling the car?
questions.zh: 为什么坎贝尔很难把汽车控制住？
questions.a: Because a tyre burst during the first run.
questions.aZh: 因为在第一段行程中爆了一只轮胎。
questions.hint: 见 because a tyre burst during the first run。

questions.q: What did Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, do many years later?
questions.zh: 多年以后，他的儿子唐纳德做了什么？
questions.a: Following in his father's footsteps, he also set up a world record, driving a car called Bluebird like his father.
questions.aZh: 他踏着父亲的足迹，也驾驶一辆名叫“蓝鸟”的汽车创造了一项世界纪录。

questions.q: Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, but he was still disappointed. Why?
questions.zh: 时速已超过304英里，为什么仍然失望？
questions.a: Because the record is based on average speed, not on the highest speed reached. His average was only 299 miles per hour, one mile short of 300, and the burst tyre had slowed him down.
questions.aZh: 因为纪录按平均时速计算而非最高时速：他的平均时速只有299英里，差1英里不到300，而爆胎拖慢了车子。

translation:
杰出的赛车选手马尔科姆。
坎贝尔爵士是第一个以每小时超过300英里的速度驾车的人。
他于1935年9月在犹他州的邦纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。
他驾驶的“蓝鸟”牌汽车是专门为他制造的。
它的车身长30英尺，有一个2,500马力的发动机。
尽管坎贝尔达到了每小时超过304英里的速度，但他很难把汽车控制住，因为在开始的行程中爆了一只轮胎。
比赛结束后，坎贝尔非常失望地得知他的平均时速是299英里。
然而，几天之后，有人告诉他说弄错了。
他的平均时速实际是301英里。
从那时以来，赛车选手已达到每小时600英里的速度。
很多年之后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德踏着父亲的足迹，也创造了一项世界纪录。
同他父亲一样，他也驾驶着一辆名叫“蓝鸟”的汽车。
title: A car called Bluebird
subtitle: “蓝鸟”汽车

lead.question: 坎贝尔失望地以为自己没破纪录，究竟是哪里出了错？
lead.warmup: 1935年9月，马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士驾驶“蓝鸟”赛车，在犹他州邦纳维尔盐滩冲击每小时300英里的极限。最高时速超过304英里，却因爆胎难以操控；赛后得知平均时速只有299英里，与纪录擦肩而过。几天后错误被纠正：实际是301英里。多年后，其子唐纳德驾驶同名“蓝鸟”再创纪录。
goals: 理解课文，能复述坎贝尔父子两代驾驶“蓝鸟”赛车创纪录的经过
掌握 the first man to do、have difficulty (in) doing、be disappointed to do/that 等句型
熟练运用 set up a record、at a speed of、per、average speed、horsepower 等搭配
复习第2/第3类条件句、被动语态与间接引语
lead.summary: 本课讲述坎贝尔父子两代驾驶“蓝鸟”赛车创纪录的故事。重点：the first man to do 中不定式作定语；have difficulty (in) doing sth.；be disappointed to do/that；follow in sb.'s footsteps。搭配：set up a record、at a speed of、average speed。还要注意 per 表“每”、burst 三态同形。
lead.tips: per 多用于商业与技术用语；have difficulty 后接 (in) doing；burst 的过去式、过去分词仍是 burst。

exercises.q: 选词填空（racing / per / horsepower / average / burst / footsteps）：The great ___ driver drove at over 300 miles ___ hour; his car had a 2,500-___ engine; his ___ speed was 301 miles an hour; a tyre ___ during the first run; following in his father's ___ , Donald also set up a world record.
exercises.a: racing; per; horsepower; average; burst; footsteps

exercises.q: 汉译英：杰出的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士是第一个以每小时超过300英里的速度驾车的人。
exercises.a: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
exercises.note: the first 后接不定式作定语。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他于1935年9月在犹他州邦纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。
exercises.a: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.

exercises.q: 同义改写：It was very difficult for him to control the car. → He ___ great ___ (in) ___ the car.
填空（他很失望地得知……）：He ___ ___ ___ ___ that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
填空：A tyre ___ during the first run.（第一段行程中爆了一只轮胎）
汉译英（第3类条件句）：如果轮胎没有爆，他控制汽车就不会有那么大的困难。
exercises.a: If the tyre had not burst during the first run, he would not have had so much difficulty (in) controlling the car.

quiz.q: “第一个以每小时超过300英里的速度驾车的人”应选哪项？
options: the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour
the first man driving at over 300 miles per hour
the first man who drive at over 300 miles per hour
the first man for driving at over 300 miles per hour
quiz.note: the first 后用不定式作定语。

quiz.q: “他很难把汽车控制住”的正确表达是？
options: He had great difficulty to control the car.
He had great difficulty in controlling the car.
He had great difficulty for controlling the car.
He had great difficulty controlling of the car.

quiz.q: “他很失望地得知平均时速只有299英里”应译为？
options: He was disappointing to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
He disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
He was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
He was disappointed learning that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
quiz.note: 人作主语用 -ed 形容词。

quiz.q: “几天之后，有人告诉他说弄错了”的正确英文是？
options: A few days later, he told that a mistake had been made.
A few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
A few days later, he was telling that a mistake has been made.
A few days later, he had told that a mistake was made.
quiz.note: 被动语态 + 间接引语。

quiz.q: “踏着父亲的足迹”的固定搭配是？
options: follow after his father's steps
follow in his father's footsteps
follow with his father's footsteps
follow on his father's footstep

quiz.q: “如果轮胎没有爆，他控制汽车就不会那么困难”如何译成第3类条件句？
options: If the tyre did not burst, he would not have so much difficulty controlling the car.
If the tyre had not burst, he would not have had so much difficulty controlling the car.
If the tyre would not burst, he had not had so much difficulty controlling the car.
If the tyre has not burst, he will not have so much difficulty controlling the car.
quiz.note: if had done, would have done。
